descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in luxury, operates in over 45 countries with the brands PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's and Car Shoe, and employs over 100 nationalities.

SCOPE

The researched figure has a strong sensitivity to the product and a technical background in the area Luxury Clothing with proven experience on technical outerwear. Within the Prada Men Lifestyle Division, he will be responsible for managing the production chain related to sportswear, overseeing activities and operating flows of about 60 people. The role involves the coordination of the chain in the stages of prototyping, sampling and production, ensuring efficiency, quality and alignment with the Group's stylistic and industrial needs.

RESPONSIBILITY

- Management and coordination of personnel (approximately 60 people) and organization of the chain and workflow to meet the different needs (swimming, prototyping, sampling, production, advertising).
- Management of relations and information with the offices and departments closely linked (Product Office, Modelling, Cad, Production, Quality Control)
- Resolution of technical criticalities that can intervene in the development of a leader
- Develop reports about the progress of a collection.

REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent technical knowledge of luxury sportswear men's outerwear, made of nylon and technical fabrics
- 10-15 years of experience in the role of Laboratory Manager and/or External Technical Inspectorate
- Good knowledge of sewing machines and the ability to use them
- Autonomy in using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Personnel management skills and job distribution and monitoring within the team
- Ability to develop reporting related to state of collection advancement.
- Aver obtained a frequency certificate at a specific course in clothing will be considered a plus.
- Retail care, flexibility and product sensitivity

What we offer

- Joining our company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the pursuit of excellence.
- The engine of our success is the importance and value we give to the talent and passion of our people, encouraging their professional growth.
- The Prada Group promotes an inclusive working environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics.
We believe diversity is a value and we are committed to building a fair and respectful working environment for all.
descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's e Car Shoe, e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

SCOPO

La figura ricercata ha una forte sensibilità al prodotto e un background tecnico in area Abbigliamento di lusso con comprovata esperienza su capospalla tecnico. All’interno della Divisione Prada Uomo Lifestyle, sarà responsabile della gestione della catena produttiva relativa al capospalla sportswear, supervisionando attività e flussi operativi di circa 60 persone. Il ruolo prevede il coordinamento della catena nelle fasi di prototipia, campionario e produzione, garantendo efficienza, qualità e allineamento con le esigenze stilistiche e industriali del Gruppo.

RESPONSABILITÀ

- Gestione e coordinamento del personale (circa 60 persone) e organizzazione della catena e del flusso di lavoro per far fronte alle diverse esigenze (sfilate, prototipia, campionario, produzione, pubblicità).
- Gestione dei rapporti e delle informazioni con gli uffici e i reparti strettamente collegati (Ufficio Prodotto, Modelleria, Cad, Produzione, Controllo qualità)
- Risoluzione di criticità tecniche che possono intervenire nello sviluppo di un capo
- Sviluppare reportistiche relative allo stato di avanzamento di una collezione.

REQUISITI E CONOSCENZE

- Ottima conoscenza tecnica del capospalla uomo sportswear di lusso, realizzato in nylon e tessuti tecnici
- 10-15 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Responsabile Laboratorio e/o Ispettore Tecnico Laboratori esterni
- Buona conoscenza delle macchine da cucire e capacità di utilizzo delle stesse
- Autonomia nell’utilizzo di Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Capacità di Gestione del personale e distribuzione e monitoraggio del lavoro all’interno del team
- Capacità di sviluppare reportistica relativa a stato avanzamento di collezione.
- Aver ottenuto un attestato di frequenza ad un corso specifico in ambito abbigliamento verrà considerato un plus.
- Cura del dettaglio, flessibilità e sensibilità al prodotto

Cosa offriamo

- Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza.
- Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale.
- Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali.
- Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada-Gruppe wurde auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation aufgebaut. Mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's und Car Shoe betreibt die Gruppe, ein weltweit führender Luxuskonzern, in über 45 Ländern und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten.

ANWENDUNG

Die erforschte Figur hat eine starke Empfindlichkeit gegenüber dem Produkt und einen technischen Hintergrund im Bereich Luxuskleidung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung auf technische Oberbekleidung. Innerhalb der Prada Men Lifestyle Division wird er für die Verwaltung der Produktionskette im Zusammenhang mit Sportbekleidung, Betreuung von Aktivitäten und Betriebsabläufen von etwa 60 Personen verantwortlich sein. Die Rolle ist die Koordination der Kette in den Stadien der Prototyping, Probenahme und Produktion, die Effizienz, Qualität und Ausrichtung mit dem stilistischen und industriellen Bedarf der Gruppe zu gewährleisten.

RESPONSIBILITÄT

- Management und Koordination des Personals (etwa 60 Personen) und Organisation der Kette und des Workflows, um die verschiedenen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen (Schwimmen, Prototyping, Probenahmen, Produktion, Werbung).
- Management von Beziehungen und Informationen mit den Büros und Abteilungen eng verbunden (Produktbüro, Modellierung, Cad, Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle)
- Auflösung von technischen Kritiken, die in die Entwicklung eines Führers eingreifen können
- Erarbeiten Sie Berichte über den Fortschritt einer Sammlung.

ANFORDERUNGEN

- Ausgezeichnete technische Kenntnisse der Luxus-Sportbekleidung Herren Oberbekleidung, aus Nylon und technischen Stoffen
- 10-15 Jahre Erfahrung in der Rolle des Laborleiters und/oder externer technischer Inspektion
- Gute Kenntnisse der Nähmaschinen und die Fähigkeit, sie zu verwenden
- Autonomie bei der Verwendung von Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Personalmanagementfähigkeiten und Jobverteilung und -überwachung im Team
- Fähigkeit, Reporting im Zusammenhang mit dem Stand der Erhebung zu entwickeln.
- Aver erhält ein Frequenzzertifikat mit einem bestimmten Kurs in der Kleidung wird als Plus betrachtet.
- Einzelhandel, Flexibilität und Produktempfindlichkeit

Was wir bieten

- Unser Unternehmen zu begleiten bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und dem Streben nach Exzellenz motiviert sind.
- Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und Wert, die wir dem Talent und der Leidenschaft unserer Menschen geben und ihr berufliches Wachstum fördern.
- Die Prada Group fördert ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld und gewährleistet Chancengleichheit für alle Kandidaten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen.
Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist, und wir sind verpflichtet, ein faires und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld für alle aufzubauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'appuie sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's et Car Shoe, et emploie plus de 100 nationalités.

PORTÉE

La figure étudiée a une forte sensibilité au produit et un arrière-plan technique dans le domaine Vêtements de luxe avec une expérience prouvée sur les vêtements extérieurs techniques. Au sein de la Division du style de vie de Prada Men, il sera chargé de gérer la chaîne de production liée aux vêtements de sport, de superviser les activités et les flux opérationnels d'une soixantaine de personnes. Ce rôle implique la coordination de la chaîne aux stades du prototypage, de l'échantillonnage et de la production, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et l'alignement avec les besoins stylistiques et industriels du Groupe.

RESPONSABILITÉ

- Gestion et coordination du personnel (environ 60 personnes) et organisation de la chaîne et du flux de travail pour répondre aux différents besoins (baignoire, prototypage, échantillonnage, production, publicité).
- Gestion des relations et des informations avec les bureaux et départements étroitement liés (Bureau des produits, Modélisation, Cad, Production, Contrôle de la qualité)
- Résolution des criticités techniques qui peuvent intervenir dans le développement d'un leader
- Élaborer des rapports sur l'état d'avancement d'une collection.

EXIGENCES

- Excellente connaissance technique des vêtements de sport de luxe pour hommes, en nylon et tissus techniques
- 10-15 ans d'expérience dans le rôle de directeur de laboratoire et/ou d'inspection technique externe
- Bonne connaissance des machines à coudre et aptitude à les utiliser
- Autonomie en utilisant Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Compétences en gestion du personnel et répartition et suivi des emplois au sein de l'équipe
- Capacité d'élaborer des rapports sur l'avancement de la collecte.
- Aver obtenu un certificat de fréquence à un cours spécifique en vêtements sera considéré comme un plus.
- Soins au détail, flexibilité et sensibilité au produit

Ce que nous offrons

- Se joindre à notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence.
- Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de notre peuple, en favorisant leur développement professionnel.
- Le Groupe Prada favorise un environnement de travail inclusif, assurant des chances égales à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles.
Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

• Affiancamento nella gestione delle procedure di emergenza e sorveglianza sanitaria.

Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's e Car Shoe, e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità. SCOPO Per ampliamento del nostro team, siamo alla ricerca di operai specializzati nella produzione di pelletteria, da inserire nei reparti di produzione per i brand Prada e Miu Miu. Nello specifico, ricerchiamo:
• Addetto/a macchina da cucire : esperti nella cucitura e assemblaggio di prodotti in pelle tramite macchine da cucire industriali piana, a colonna, a braccio, ecc.)
• Addetto/a al banco – Grande e Piccola Pelletteria: specializzati nel montaggio, incollaggio, colore, rifinitura e assemblaggio di prodotti in pelle
• Addetto/a alla Preparazione RESPONSABILITÀ
• Eseguire le lavorazioni nel rispetto degli standard qualitativi richiesti.
• Controllo qualità del prodotto durante le varie fasi di lavorazione.
• Utilizzo corretto di attrezzature e macchinari specifici del settore.
• Collaborazione con il team per garantire il rispetto delle tempistiche di produzione REQUISITI E CONOSCENZE Esperienza nel ruolo di addetto al Banco, alla Macchina da cucire di almeno 3 anni nel settore della pelletteria di lusso. Conoscenza delle tecniche di lavorazione della pelle. Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e buona manualità. Capacità di lavorare in team e di gestire le proprie attività in autonomia. Flessibilità e capacità di adattamento a diverse fasi della produzione. • Addetto/a macchina da cucire : esperti nella cucitura e assemblaggio di prodotti in pelle tramite macchine da cucire industriali piana, a colonna, a braccio, ecc.)

• Eseguire le lavorazioni nel rispetto degli standard qualitativi richiesti.
• Controllo qualità del prodotto durante le varie fasi di lavorazione.

Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 
 

 
 

 JOB DETAILS 

 
 We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Client Advisor (m/f/d) to join our dynamic team in our PRADA Store in Dusseldorf. As a Client Advisor, you will embody the essence of PRADA, ensuring that every customer interaction reflects our commitment to excellence. You will engage with our clients, understand their unique preferences, and offer expert advice to enhance their brand experience. 

 
 At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and our Client Advisors play a pivotal role in providing personalized service and creating memorable moments for our discerning customers.

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
 

• Maintain and develop client relationships through an individual approach, leveraging also on CRM and digital tools.
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross-selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
 

• Contribute to ensuring a high level of security and is attentive to preventing product thefts.
 
 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to connect with a diverse clientele.

 
 Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to meet and exceed sales targets.

 
 Passion for luxury fashion trends, and an understanding of the luxury retail market.

 
 Fluent spoken German and English expected.

 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 Job summary/purpose 

 
 

 
 You are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader/partner, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the Store team and to the final Client. 

 
 

 
 You hold yourself accountable for achieving a successful performance in your Department, supporting and implementing all activities to achieve the targets. 

 
 

 
 You guarantee excellence in Client experience, by being present on the sales floor and leading by example to placing the Client above all. 

 
 

 
 You are a motivating and inspiring manager; you coach and work closely with your team to achieve their sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities 

 
 

 
 Responsibilities 

 
 

 
 Leading the Business 

 
 

• 
 

• Drive the Department team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances and contribution to support the success of the entire store 
 

• Support the Store Manager to develop and implement business plans, through the analysis of the department’s performances and proposal of relevant action plans 
 

• Drive the Department team to exceed their KPI targets 
 

• Foster cross selling and up selling among product categories 
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients. 
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business objectives 
 

• Foster the E-commerce channel development through a timely response to orders received, always delivering a high standard of service 
 

• Be constantly up-to-date on market trends (especially in relation to your department) and share ınsıghts wıth relevant functıons 
 

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Client development 

 
 

• 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request 
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences 
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony” 
 

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow department sales 
 

• Strengthen Client loyalty supporting the Department team to carry out clienteling initiatives 
 

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Team management 

 
 

• 
 

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team sp ı r ı t through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client 
 

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics 
 

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates
 

• Having understood the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Department sales team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures 
 

• Identify talents within a team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Store Manager in order to define the correct development processes 
 

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;
 

• Actively support the Store Manager in mapping the market for any researches they may have 
 

• Lead by example to ensure that the team operates with the highest level of care and respects for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Store Care 

 
 

• 
 

• Support synergy and cooperation between front and back of house 
 

• Support enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office 
 

• Contribute to an effect ı ve and eff ı c ı ent care of Company’s assets 
 

• Prov ı de feedback and suggestions concerning department needs firstly to the Store Manager, and if necessary with the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments 
 

• Be the guarantor for an effect ı ve and eff ı c ı ent back of house organization for the department, taking responsibility for the protect ı on of the company’s assets as well as ensuring the staff grooming standard is maintained; 
 

• You ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Department. 
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 
 
 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty.

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts.
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 

 
 Passion for selling and stores

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category

 
 English is a must other languages are a plus

 
 
 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. MISSIONS La Maison MIU MIU recherche pour cet été plusieurs stagiaires qui évolueront sur des fonctions de Client Advisor. Chez Miu Miu , le Client Advisor agit en tant qu’Ambassadeur et partage aux clients la philosophie et les valeurs de la Maison. Il assure son rôle dans le but de maximiser les performances de vente grâce à la création de relations fortes et durables avec les clients. Il développe la fidélité de ces derniers en les faisant bénéficier d’une expérience unique en point de vente, et en les guidant au sein de l’univers de la Maison. RESPONSABILITÉS
• · Accueillir et faire bénéficier les clients d’une expérience en point de vente reflétant les hauts standards du luxe et de la Maison.
• · Entretenir et développer des relations privilégiées avec les clients grâce à une approche personnalisée et renforcée par l’utilisation d’outils CRM et digitaux.
• · Maximiser les opportunités de vente et faciliter le cross-selling avec l’ensemble des catégories de produit du point de vente afin d’atteindre les objectifs de vente individuels et de KPIs.
• · Démontrer une excellente connaissance de la Maison et de ses produits.
• · Se tenir constamment à jour des tendances mode et de l’offre de la concurrence.
• · Prendre en charge les litiges clients en faisant le lien avec le manager dans certains cas.
• · S’assurer de la bonne tenue de la surface de vente et du respect permanent des standards de display ainsi que des consignes opérationnelles et des procédures de stock de la Maison.
• · Contribuer au maintien des consignes de sécurité, notamment afin d’éviter les vols sur le point de vente. CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES
• Forte appétence pour la vente et les relations humaines.
• Curiosité et intérêt marqué pour le luxe, la mode, l’art et le design.
• Capacité à résoudre les problèmes de manière efficace et rapide.
• Expérience démontrée dans la création et le développement de relations clients.
• Esprit d’équipe ainsi que capacité à travailler en autonomie. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 We are looking for a 24h-parttime Cashier (m/f/d) for our PRADA Outlet in Roermond who supports the activities connected to cash collection (payments, advances, returns, invoices, credit notes, bank transfers for distance selling, deposits) following the Corporate guidelines.

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Execute cash opening and closing procedures, verifying cash availability in cash registers and the functioning of equipment to be used.
 

• Issue national, international and tax free invoices in compliance with local laws.
 

• Support advances, returns (returns are normally processed by sales associates), issuance of vouchers and credit notes to customers.
 

• Follow CITES procedures – for products needing them.
 

• Monitor credit card payments and bank transfers.
 

• Carry out and print daily cash register closing, checking daily cash in
 

• Prepare paying-in slips and, where necessary, the documents for periodical withdrawal, managing delivery and relevant receipts.
 

• Update the company’s customer database.
 

• Manage petty cash in compliance with corporate procedures in terms of expense limits.
 
 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Related experience, Retail channel preferred

 
 Good integrity, organized, strong sense of responsibility

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone

 
 Fluent spoken English expected

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. • Prove Brand and product knowledge.

The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB DETAILS We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Client Advisor (m/f/d) to join our dynamic team in our PRADA Store in Dusseldorf. This position is limited. As a Client Advisor, you will embody the essence of PRADA, ensuring that every customer interaction reflects our commitment to excellence. You will engage with our clients, understand their unique preferences, and offer expert advice to enhance their brand experience. At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and our Client Advisors play a pivotal role in providing personalized service and creating memorable moments for our discerning customers. RESPONSIBILITIES
• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
• Maintain and develop client relationships through an individual approach, leveraging also on CRM and digital tools.
• Be proactively engaged in cross-selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
• Contribute to ensuring a high level of security and is attentive to preventing product thefts. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to connect with a diverse clientele. Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to meet and exceed sales targets. Passion for luxury fashion trends, and an understanding of the luxury retail market. Fluent spoken German and English expected. Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Church’s is a luxury shoemaker of rich innovation and traditional excellence, anchored in an exceptional heritage of English craftsmanship. Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. 
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. 
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. 
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. 
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge. 
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. 
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. 
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 

 
 Passion for selling and stores 

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design 

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving 

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. 
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. 
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. 
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. 
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge. 
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. 
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. 
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 

 
 Passion for selling and stores 

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design 

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving 

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Descrizione Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità. All’interno della Modelleria RTW basata a Montevarchi, stiamo strutturando un reparto di Modelleria dedicato all’abbigliamento tecnico-sportivo di Prada Linea Rossa. Le risorse si interfacceranno frequentemente con i team di stile e prodotto basati a Milano. Nell’ambito di questo progetto, ricerchiamo: - Un/a Modellista RTW Performance Leggero (abbigliamento per running, training, tennis e sport estivi) con consolidata esperienza su prodotto leggero performance, preferibilmente con focus su running. - Un/a Modellista RTW Performance Pesante (sci, snowboard e sport invernali) con consolidata esperienza su capospalla invernale (capi imbottiti e piumini tecnici) ## Scopo Le risorse saranno coinvolte nello sviluppo di capi tecnici ad alte prestazioni, lavorando su collezioni caratterizzate da un forte contenuto funzionale, ergonomico e innovativo. I/Le Modellisti/e si occuperanno dello sviluppo del modello a partire dal disegno, realizzando basi e modelli in autonomia, a mano e a CAD/3D, traducendo l’idea dello Stile in un capo performante, in grado di rispondere alle esigenze di movimento, fisicità dell’atleta e utilizzo sportivo. Nel ruolo è centrale la capacità di lavorare su tabelle misure complesse e su progetti tailor ‑ made dedicati ad atleti, in stretta collaborazione con Ufficio Stile e Ufficio Sviluppo Prodotto. ## Responsabilità - Sviluppare e impostare i modelli di capi performance partendo dal disegno, creando basi e modelli in autonomia attraverso l’utilizzo di PGS-Investronica e CLO-3D - Interpretare le esigenze funzionali del prodotto in relazione alla fisicità e al movimento dell’atleta, garantendo comfort, performance ed ergonomia. - Lavorare in modo approfondito su tabelle misure, grading e fitting tecnici. - Segnalare criticità tecniche e costruttive nelle prime fasi di prototipazione. - Seguire il processo di confezionamento dei capi, fornendo indicazioni ai laboratori sulle tecniche più idonee alla realizzazione di capi tecnici. - Collaborare attivamente con Ufficio Stile e Ufficio Prodotto durante fitting e prove di sdifettamento, apportando le modifiche necessarie ai modelli. ## 
• Requisiti - Diploma con specializzazione nel settore abbigliamento. - 8–10 anni di esperienza come modellista abbigliamento tecnico/sportivo, maturati principalmente in brand e aziende nel segmento sportivo ad alte prestazioni. - Autonomia completa nello sviluppo del modello (dal disegno alla base e al modello finito). - Ottima conoscenza di software CAD 2D e 3D per l’abbigliamento. - Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese. - Disponibilità a frequenti spostamenti sul territorio nazionale. ## 
• Cosa offriamo Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale. ## Contatto Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in over 45 countries with the brands PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa and employs over 100 nationalities. Within the Modelleria RTW based in Montevarchi, we are building a Modelleria department dedicated to technical-sports clothing of Prada Linea Rossa. Resources will frequently interface with style and product teams based in Milan. Within this project, we are looking for: - A Modeller RTW Performance Lightweight (wear for running, training, tennis and summer sports) with consolidated experience on light performance, preferably with focus on running. - A Modeller RTW Performance Pesante (skiing, snowboarding and winter sports) with consolidated experience on winter spring (padded helmets and technical duvets) Purpose The resources will be involved in the development of high-performance technical garments, working on collections characterized by a strong functional, ergonomic and innovative content. I/Le Modellisti/e will take care of the development of the model starting from the design, creating bases and models independently, by hand and CAD/3D, translating the idea of the Style into a performing garment, able to respond to the needs of movement, physicality of the athlete and sports use. The role is central to the ability to work on complex measurements tables and tailor-made projects dedicated to athletes, in close collaboration with Office Style and Office Product Development. Liability - Develop and set the models of performance garments starting from the design, creating bases and models independently through the use of PGS-Investronica and CLO-3D - Interpret the functional requirements of the product in relation to the physicality and movement of the athlete, ensuring comfort, performance and ergonomics. - Work in depth on measurements, grading and technical fittings. - Report technical and constructive criticism in the early stages of prototyping. - Follow the packaging process of the garments, providing information to the laboratories on the techniques most suitable for the realization of technical garments. - Actively collaborate with Office Style and Product Office during fitting and undipping tests, making the necessary changes to models. 
• Requirements Diploma with specialization in the clothing industry. - 8–10 years of experience as a technical/sporty clothing model, matured mainly in brands and companies in the high performance sports segment. - Complete autonomy in model development (from design to base and finished model). - Excellent knowledge of CAD 2D and 3D software for clothing. - Great knowledge of Italian and English. - Availability to frequent movements in the national territory. 
• What we offer Joining our company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the pursuit of excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value we give to the talent and passion of our people, encouraging their professional growth. Contact The Prada Group promotes an inclusive working environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to building a fair and respectful working environment for all.

Warenbezeichnung Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada-Gruppe wurde auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation aufgebaut. Mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe und Luna Rossa betreibt die Gruppe, ein Weltmarktführer im Luxussektor, in über 45 Ländern und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten. Innerhalb der Modelleria RTW mit Sitz in Montevarchi bauen wir eine Modellria-Abteilung für technische Sportkleidung von Prada Linea Rossa. Ressourcen werden häufig mit Stil- und Produktteams mit Sitz in Mailand verbunden. In diesem Projekt suchen wir: - Ein Modeller RTW Performance Lightweight (Bekleidung für Laufen, Training, Tennis und Sommersport) mit konsolidierter Erfahrung auf Lichtleistung, vorzugsweise mit Fokus auf Laufen. - Ein Modeller RTW Performance Pesante (Ski-, Snowboard- und Wintersport) mit konsolidierter Erfahrung im Winter Frühjahr (Gepolsterte Helme und technische Bettdecken) Zweck Die Ressourcen werden an der Entwicklung von leistungsstarken technischen Kleidungsstücken beteiligt sein, die an Kollektionen arbeiten, die sich durch einen starken funktionalen, ergonomischen und innovativen Inhalt auszeichnen. I/Le Modellisti/e kümmert sich um die Entwicklung des Modells ausgehend vom Design, die Erstellung von Basen und Modellen unabhängig, von Hand und CAD/3D, übersetzen die Idee des Stils in ein performatives Kleidungsstück, in der Lage, auf die Bedürfnisse der Bewegung, der Körperlichkeit des Sportlers und des Sporteinsatzes zu reagieren. Die Rolle ist zentral für die Fähigkeit, an komplexen Messtabellen und maßgeschneiderten Projekten für Sportler zu arbeiten, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Office Style und Office Product Development. Haftung - Entwickeln und setzen Sie die Modelle von Performance Kleidungsstücken ausgehend vom Design und schaffen Basis und Modelle unabhängig durch die Verwendung von PGS-Investronica und CLO-3D - Interpret die funktionellen 
• Anforderungen des Produktes in Bezug auf die Körperlichkeit und Bewegung des Sportlers, um Komfort, Leistung und Ergonomie zu gewährleisten. - Arbeiten Sie in der Tiefe an Messungen, Abstufungen und technischen Armaturen. - Berichten Sie technische und konstruktive Kritik in den frühen Stadien des Prototypings. - Befolgen Sie den Verpackungsvorgang der Kleidungsstücke und geben Sie den Labors Informationen über die Techniken, die für die Realisierung von technischen Kleidungsstücken am besten geeignet sind. - Aktiv mit Office Style und Product Office während der Montage- und Reißprüfungen zusammenarbeiten und die notwendigen Änderungen an Modellen vornehmen. 
• Anforderungen Diplom mit Spezialisierung in der Bekleidungsindustrie. - 8–10 Jahre Erfahrung als technisches/sportliches Bekleidungsmodell, gereift vor allem in Marken und Unternehmen im Hochleistungssportsegment. - Vollständige Autonomie in der Modellentwicklung (von Design bis Basis und fertigem Modell). - Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der CAD 2D- und 3D-Software für Bekleidung. - Großes Wissen über Italienisch und Englisch. - Verfügbarkeit von häufigen Bewegungen im nationalen Gebiet. 
• Was wir bieten Unser Unternehmen zu begleiten bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und dem Streben nach Exzellenz motiviert sind. Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und Wert, die wir dem Talent und der Leidenschaft unserer Menschen geben und ihr berufliches Wachstum fördern. Kontakt Die Prada Group fördert ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, um Chancengleichheit für alle Kandidaten zu gewährleisten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist, und wir sind verpflichtet, ein faires und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld für alle aufzubauen.

Désignation des marchandises Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'appuie sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe et Luna Rossa et emploie plus de 100 nationalités. Au sein de Modelleria RTW basé à Montevarchi, nous construisons un département de Modelleria dédié aux vêtements de sport technique de Prada Linea Rossa. Les ressources s'interfacent souvent avec des équipes de style et de produits basées à Milan. Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous cherchons : - Un Modeller RTW Performance Léger (vêtement pour la course, l'entraînement, le tennis et les sports d'été) avec une expérience consolidée sur la performance légère, de préférence en mettant l'accent sur la course. - Un Modeller RTW Performance Pesante (ski, snowboard et sports d'hiver) avec une expérience consolidée sur le printemps d'hiver ( casques rembourrés et duvets techniques) Objet Les ressources seront associées au développement de vêtements techniques de haute performance, travaillant sur des collections caractérisées par un contenu fonctionnel, ergonomique et innovant. I/Le Modellisti/e s'occupera du développement du modèle à partir de la conception, créant des bases et des modèles indépendamment, à la main et CAD/3D, traduisant l'idée du Style en un vêtement performant, capable de répondre aux besoins du mouvement, de la physique de l'athlète et de l'utilisation sportive. Le rôle est central pour la capacité de travailler sur des tables de mesure complexes et des projets sur mesure dédiés aux athlètes, en étroite collaboration avec Office Style et Office Product Development. Responsabilité - Développer et définir les modèles de vêtements de performance à partir de la conception, créer des bases et des modèles indépendamment grâce à l'utilisation de PGS-Investronica et CLO-3D - Interpréter les exigences fonctionnelles du produit par rapport à la physique et au mouvement de l'athlète, en assurant confort, performance et ergonomie. - Travailler en profondeur sur les mesures, le classement et les accessoires techniques. - Faire état de critiques techniques et constructives dans les premiers stades du prototypage. - Suivre le processus d'emballage des vêtements, en fournissant des informations aux laboratoires sur les techniques les plus appropriées pour la réalisation des vêtements techniques. - Collaborer activement avec Office Style et Product Office lors des essais de montage et d'immersion, apportant les changements nécessaires aux modèles. 
• Exigences Diplôme avec spécialisation dans l'industrie de l'habillement. - 8-10 ans d'expérience en tant que modèle technique/sportif, mûri principalement dans les marques et les entreprises du segment sportif de haute performance. - L'autonomie complète dans le développement de modèles (de la conception à la base et au modèle fini). - Excellente connaissance des logiciels CAO 2D et 3D pour les vêtements. - Bonne connaissance de l'italien et de l'anglais. - Disponibilité aux déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national. Ce que nous offrons Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de notre peuple, en favorisant leur développement professionnel. Personne à contacter Le groupe Prada favorise un environnement de travail inclusif, assurant l'égalité des chances à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

JOB PURPOSE As Prada Client Advisor, You guarantee an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience, placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships, serving as a Brand Ambassador. You convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of Prada. You hold yourself accountable to achieve your individual and team sales target, acting as proactive player in ensuring the best service and responding to the customer needs for both in store and on ecommerce channel. RESPONSIBILITIES • Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”; • Be driven to exceed individual sales targets and maximize own sales performances contributing to the success of the entire store; • Be driven to exceed KPI goals, ensuring the highest quality of sales and customer service; • Demonstrate an excellence knowledge of the products as well as Prada history, culture and DNA; • Capture Customer data into the Company CRM to connect to the client, maintain and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities; • Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset; • Build and maintain an ample knowledge of the world of luxury fashion by being constantly informed on fashion trends and competitors, with the purpose to be able to discuss them with the customers and to give advises; • Take ownership of resolving Client complaints liaising with the line manager and Client Service team, when necessary; • Operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Products; • Utilize Company digital tools actively to offer a complete and integrated luxury experience; • Host and conduct customer appointments either in presence or leveraging technology to do virtual meeting; • Work in synergy with the Back of House, participating to the daily operations of the store and maintaining an organized stock room; • Act in compliance to Company procedures on operational guidelines and stock procedures, as well as security, cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office, ensuring that Company policies and procedures are proactively executed; • Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 You support the Stock Manager in all the responsibilities related to the warehouse management and in providing services to the Store. 

 
 You ensure the correct handling of goods in store, complying with the KPI’s and guidelines and company procedures for the care of the product. 

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Ensure the care and protection of the product according to company guidelines 
 

• Day-to-day management of goods receipt and storage in line with company 
 
 
 procedures and criteria, preparing products to be brought to the sales floor and 

 
 in special areas while optimizing the timing efficiency 

 
 

• Prepare shop-to-shop and returns transfers in compliance with company 
 
 
 guidelines and timelines 

 
 

• Prepare the flow of E-Commerce orders (Prada.com or e-Tailers) making sure to 
 

• guarantee the required service levels 
 

• Prepare the flow of the damaged products, not sellable product (On Hold, 
 
 
 Consignment ...), products under repair 

 
 

• Organizes the Packaging and Stationery physically and on the IT systems 
 

• Organizes the Display objects system 
 

• Ensure that the company guidelines are adopted in the event of theft, especially 
 
 
 in terms of communication and documentation produced 

 
 

• Support in the prompt investigation in the event of system negatives 
 

• Participate in the organization and execution of the Physical and Cycle 
 
 
 Inventories of the finished product and accessory locations (packaging / 

 
 stationery and Engineering materials) respecting the company timing 

 
 

• Support the management of the warehouse activities related to sales 
 

• Ensure security and cleanliness of the warehouse 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 

 
 Fluent spoken English expected. 

 
 High sense of responsibility. 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone. 

 
 Organized and detail oriented. 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 Job summary/purpose 

 
 

 
 As the Store Manager, you are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the local market, the Store team and to the final Client. 

 
 

 
 You are a driven business owner and you hold yourself accountable for achieving a successful overall store performance, seamlessly executing all activities to achieve the targets. 

 
 

 
 You guarantee excellence in Client experience, by being present on the sales floor and leading by example to placing the Client above all. 

 
 

 
 You are a motivating and inspiring leader; you coach and work closely with your team to achieve their sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities . Y ou mentor and develop your team by working closely with them; you set them up for success through succession planning and ensuring internal growth. 

 
 

 
 You ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Store. 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 Responsibilities 

 
 

 
 Leading the Business 

 
 

• Drive Store Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances, determining the success of the entire store
 

• Propose and develop action plans, through careful analysis of performance
 

• Drive the Store team to exceed their KPI targets, including cross selling and up selling among product categories
 

• Represent the Company within the local market, identifying opportunities to increase foot flow, attracting new Clients and building loyal relationships with the brand
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients.
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business
 

• Foster the E-commerce channel development through a timely response to orders received, always delivering a high standard of service
 

• Meet store operating budgets by monitoring store expenses
 

• Provide effective product feedback based on store needs, and participate in the buying session when requested
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Client Development 

 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”
 

• Seamlessly manage the store’s local VIC’s, proposing the most appropriate and tailored actions to develop their loyalty and spend
 

• In partnership with other corporate functions, implement clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending
 

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow store sales
 

• Foster a strong private appointment culture among the team
 

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Team Management 

 
 

• 
 

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team sp ı r ı t through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client
 

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics 
 

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates
 

• Understand the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Store team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures 
 

• Identify talents within your team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Retail Operations Manager in order to define the correct development processes
 

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;
 

• Attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting
 

• Ensure strong cooperation between front and back of house to guarantee efficient operations
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Boutique Care 

 
 

• 
 

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure
 

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines – proactively seek VM and MD support based on store needs
 

• Guarantee an effective and efficient care of Company’s assets
 

• Ensure enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office
 

• Prov ı de feedback and suggestions when necessary to the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Events Organization 

 
 

• 
 

• Cooperate with the Retail Head Office for the organization of local events defining a challenging and realistic target per Client
 

• Guarantee excellence in standards and service during store events
 

• Propose opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 Job summary/purpose 

 
 

 
 As the Store Manager, you are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the local market, the Store team and to the final Client. 

 
 

 
 You are a driven business owner and you hold yourself accountable for achieving a successful overall store performance, seamlessly executing all activities to achieve the targets. 

 
 

 
 You guarantee excellence in Client experience, by being present on the sales floor and leading by example to placing the Client above all. 

 
 

 
 You are a motivating and inspiring leader; you coach and work closely with your team to achieve their sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities . Y ou mentor and develop your team by working closely with them; you set them up for success through succession planning and ensuring internal growth. 

 
 

 
 You ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Store. 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 Responsibilities 

 
 

 
 Leading the Business 

 
 

• Drive Store Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances, determining the success of the entire store
 

• Propose and develop action plans, through careful analysis of performance
 

• Drive the Store team to exceed their KPI targets, including cross selling and up selling among product categories
 

• Represent the Company within the local market, identifying opportunities to increase foot flow, attracting new Clients and building loyal relationships with the brand
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients.
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business
 

• Foster the E-commerce channel development through a timely response to orders received, always delivering a high standard of service
 

• Meet store operating budgets by monitoring store expenses
 

• Provide effective product feedback based on store needs, and participate in the buying session when requested
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Client Development 

 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”
 

• Seamlessly manage the store’s local VIC’s, proposing the most appropriate and tailored actions to develop their loyalty and spend
 

• In partnership with other corporate functions, implement clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending
 

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow store sales
 

• Foster a strong private appointment culture among the team
 

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Team Management 

 
 

• 
 

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team sp ı r ı t through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client
 

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics 
 

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates
 

• Understand the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Store team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures 
 

• Identify talents within your team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Retail Operations Manager in order to define the correct development processes
 

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;
 

• Attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting
 

• Ensure strong cooperation between front and back of house to guarantee efficient operations
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Boutique Care 

 
 

• 
 

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure
 

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines – proactively seek VM and MD support based on store needs
 

• Guarantee an effective and efficient care of Company’s assets
 

• Ensure enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office
 

• Prov ı de feedback and suggestions when necessary to the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Events Organization 

 
 

• 
 

• Cooperate with the Retail Head Office for the organization of local events defining a challenging and realistic target per Client
 

• Guarantee excellence in standards and service during store events
 

• Propose opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. 
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. 
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. 
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. 
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge. 
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. 
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. 
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Passion for selling and stores 

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design 

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving 

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category
 English is a must other languages are a plus 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Vous contribuerez à notre engagement envers le luxe, le style et l'innovation en surveillant les procédures d'achat d'actions, en assurant la disponibilité des produits et en maintenant un environnement sûr pour notre clientèle estimée. Chez PRADA, nous sommes réputés pour notre engagement indéfectible envers le luxe, le style et l'innovation. En tant que leader mondial de l'industrie de la mode, nous nous engageons à offrir des expériences exceptionnelles à notre clientèle estimée. Notre marque représente une fusion de tradition et de modernité, et en tant qu'assistant Stock, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le respect de nos normes et la garantie d'une expérience client transparente. ## Responsabilità - S'assurer de gérer correctement le reçu quotidien des marchandises, d'organiser la marchandise selon les procédures de l'entreprise, de vérifier et de préparer le produit à prendre sur le plancher de vente et/ou les zones spéciales. - Assurer le bon suivi du flux de produits à travers le système SAP. - Garantir la sécurité des produits et des matériaux précieux dans l'entrepôt pendant tout le processus de manutention. - Toujours maintenir l'ordre dans l'entrepôt, selon les normes de l'entreprise. - Garantir les retours, les transferts de magasin à magasin et la livraison en ligne selon les directives et les délais de l'entreprise. - Fournir les commandes de matériel d'emballage en fonction des besoins du magasin. ## Conoscenze e competenze - Expérience de travail antérieure dans un rôle similaire - Expérience idéalement dans le secteur du luxe au détail - Haute affinité pour les produits de luxe - Haut sens des responsabilités et travail en équipe - Compétences néerlandaises et anglaises fluides ## Cosa offriamo Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la quête d'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Le groupe Prada favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant des chances égales à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.
