## Descrizione
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

## Job Title
General Manager

## JOB PURPOSE
- To be the owner of the business, a Company Brand Ambassador and a business leader, accountable for overall store performance.
- To guarantee an extraordinary Client experience, being present on the sales floor, leading and supporting all activities to achieve store targets.
- To manage and coach the store team and to ensure succession plans and internal growth.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

### BUSINESS
- Drive and maximize sales performances.
- Propose and develop business plans.
- Drive the store team to exceed their KPIs.
- Represent the Company on the local market, identifying new opportunities to increase customer footfall, attracts new Clients and builds a loyal relationship with the brand.
- Be present on the sales floor, ensuring a proper approach and service to the Clients.
- Foster the Omni Channel development through the team.
- Meet the store-operating budget, controlling store expenses.

### CUSTOMER
- Foster a Client centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.
- Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service.
- Implement, in partnership with other company functions, clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending.
- Foster a strong private appointment culture.

### TEAM
- Promote an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication, ensuring efficient organization and professional growth.
- Ensure the team is always prepared and updated on the Prada Group main information, product knowledge, local market, competitors, policies and procedures.
- The ideal Store Manager is able to attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting.

### RETAIL
- Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.
- Ensures that the display attracts Clients and maximizes sales in accordance with Company guidelines.
- Participate in the buying session when requested and in any case he/she provides effective product feedback based on store needs.
- Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.
- Is responsible for the enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all the main reporting activities requested by the head office.

### EVENTS
- Cooperate with the Retail Events Office for the organization of local events and defines a challenging and realistic target per Client, proposing new opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers.

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
- Business driven
- Leadership and team management
- Ability to motivate and persuade people
- Strong customer service mindset
- Natural ability to welcome our client
- Confident, enthusiastic and positive
- Mature and assertive
- Organized and detail oriented
- Market and product knowledge/passion
- Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus
- Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design
- English is a must other languages are a plus

## Cosa offriamo
Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale.
Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## JOB PURPOSE
As Outlet Sales Assistant, you guarantee an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience, placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships, serving as a Brand Ambassador.

You convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of Prada Group.

You hold yourself accountable to achieve your store sales target, acting as proactive player in ensuring the best service and responding to the customer needs for both in store and on ecommerce channel.

## RESPONSIBILITIES
- Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”
- Be driven to exceed individual sales targets and maximize own sales performances contributing to the success of the entire store
- Be driven to exceed KPI goals, ensuring the highest quality of sales and customer service
- Demonstrate an excellence knowledge of the products as well as Prada / Miu Miu history, culture and DNA
- Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities
- Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset
- Build and maintain an ample knowledge of the world of luxury fashion by being constantly informed on fashion trends and competitors, with the purpose to be able to discuss them with the customers and to give advises
- Take ownership of resolving Client complaints liaising with the line manager and Client Service team, when necessary
- Operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Products
- Utilize Company digital tools actively to offer a complete and integrated luxury experience
- Work in synergy with the Back of House, participating to the daily operations of the store and maintaining an organized stock room
- Act in compliance to Company procedures on operational guidelines and stock procedures, as well as security, cash activity, inventory, logistics, ensuring that Company policies and procedures are proactively executed
- Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
- Passion for building long-lasting relationships with clients and peers
- Problem solving, curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion
- Experience in a luxury or premium retail environment is a plus
- Being able to work in team, as well as alone
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Fluent spoken English expected

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. Job Title (visible by candidate): Client Advisor JOB PURPOSE To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. RESPONSIBILITIES • Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. • Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. • Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. • Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. • Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. • Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. • Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. • Prove Brand and product knowledge. • Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. • Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. • Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Passion for selling and stores Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients Being able to work in team as well as alone Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving Passion and knowledge of the managed product category English is a must other languages are a plus Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## JOB PURPOSE
You are a passionate Brand Ambassador and business leader who communicates the Brand’s philosophy and values to both the store team and the client. You take ownership of your department’s performance, actively supporting and implementing initiatives to achieve set targets. You ensure an exceptional client experience by maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor and leading by example, always placing the client at the forefront. As a motivating and inspiring manager, you coach and collaborate closely with your team to help them reach their sales targets and maximise all commercial opportunities.

## RESPONSIBILITIES
• Drive your Floor Team to exceed Financial as well as KPIs targets and maximize sales performances and contribution to support the success of the entire store.

• Support the management team to develop and implement business plans, through the analysis of the floor’s performance and proposal of relevant action plans.

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring the highest standard of approach and service to Clients.

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieve the business objectives.

• Foster the product knowledge wıthın the floor and work with relevant functions to support product/ collection training needs.

• Foster a client-centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after-sales experiences.

• Strengthen Client loyalty, supporting the department team to carry out clienteling initiatives.

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow department sales.

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure the client relationship is maintained with positive outcome.

• Act as a strong team motivator, promoting team spırıt through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment

• Having understood the needs and priorities, train and inspire the floor sales team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures.

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans.

• Actively support the management team in mapping the market for sourcing talent.

• Lead by example to ensure the team operates with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure.

• Support the enforcement of the Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by the head office.

• Provıde feedback and suggestions concerning floor needs firstly to the Store Director, and if necessary with the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments.

• Be the guarantor for an effectıve and effıcıent back of house organization for the floor, taking responsibility for the protectıon of the company’s assets as well as ensuring the staff grooming standard is maintained.

• Ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Departments.

• Ensure all the floor team is properly updated and trained on product knowledge and sales tools.

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
• Ability to drive departmental performance by exceeding financial and KPI targets, identifying commercial opportunities, and contributing to overall store success - essential in high-performing luxury retail settings.

• Demonstrated skill in delivering exceptional client service through presence on the shop floor, execution of brand ceremonies, and proactive complaint resolution.

• Prior experience in luxury or premium brands is vital to meet elevated client expectations.

• Strong leadership and motivational skills to inspire, coach, and develop a sales team.

• Experience in fast-paced environments is key to maintaining energy and focus while nurturing talent.

• Effective communicator with the ability to share insights, lead briefings, and collaborate across departments. Staying informed on market trends, especially within the luxury sector crucial for maintaining relevance and driving innovation

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

BUT DE L'EMPLOI Vous êtes un ambassadeur passionné de la marque et chef d'entreprise qui communique la philosophie et les valeurs de la marque à la fois à l'équipe de magasin et au client. Vous vous appropriez le rendement de votre ministère, soutenant activement et mettant en oeuvre des initiatives visant à atteindre les objectifs fixés. Vous assurez une expérience client exceptionnelle en maintenant une forte présence dans le magasin et en donnant l'exemple, mettant toujours le client à l'avant-garde. En tant que gestionnaire motivant et inspirant, vous coachez et collaborez étroitement avec votre équipe pour les aider à atteindre leurs objectifs commerciaux et maximiser toutes les opportunités commerciales. ## RESPONSABILITÉS • Conduire votre équipe de plancher à dépasser les objectifs financiers ainsi que les KPI et maximiser les performances de vente et la contribution pour soutenir le succès de l'ensemble du magasin. • Aider l'équipe de direction à élaborer et à mettre en oeuvre des plans d'action, en analysant les résultats obtenus et en proposant des plans d'action pertinents. • Soyez présent sur le plancher de vente, assurant le plus haut niveau d'approche et de service aux clients. • Favoriser la sensibilisation de l'équipe à l'Omni Channel, ainsi qu'encourager et soutenir l'équipe dans l'utilisation d'outils numériques pour améliorer la relation avec les clients et atteindre les objectifs opérationnels. • Favoriser la connaissance du produit dans le sol et travailler avec les fonctions pertinentes pour soutenir les besoins de formation produit/collecte. • Favoriser un état d'esprit axé sur le client en développant et en maintenant des relations solides avec le client et en appliquant des expériences après-vente significatives. • Renforcer la loyauté de la clientèle, en aidant l'équipe du Ministère à mener des initiatives de clientèle. • Identifier de manière proactive les possibilités d'obtenir de nouveaux clients afin d'accroître les ventes des ministères. • Gérer proactivement les plaintes des clients pour s'assurer que la relation client est maintenue avec un résultat positif. • Agir en tant qu'équipe forte motivatrice, promouvoir l'équipe spırıt par une communication efficace, et cultiver un environnement positif et énergique • Ayant compris les besoins et les priorités, former et inspirer l'équipe de vente au sol sur la connaissance des produits, les techniques de vente, les services à la clientèle, et les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise. • Garantir le développement d'équipes par le biais d'un encadrement et d'un suivi des plans d'action individuels. • Aider activement l'équipe de gestion à cartographier le marché des talents d'approvisionnement. • Diriger par exemple pour s'assurer que l'équipe fonctionne avec le plus haut niveau de soin et de respect pour le produit, évident dans chaque cérémonie ou procédure. • Appuyer l'application des procédures de la Société en matière d'activité de trésorerie, d'inventaire, de logistique et de toutes les principales activités d'information demandées par le siège social. • Provıde feedback et suggestions concernant les besoins de plancher d'abord au directeur du magasin, et si nécessaire avec les services de marchandisation visuelle et de détail. • Soyez le garant d'un effetıve et effıcıent dos de l'organisation de la maison pour le plancher, en assumant la responsabilité de la protection de l'actif de la société et en assurant le maintien de la norme de toilettage du personnel. • Veiller à ce que les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise soient mises en place de manière proactive tout en gérant toutes les activités opérationnelles liées à vos ministères. • Veiller à ce que toute l'équipe de plancher soit correctement mise à jour et formée aux connaissances des produits et aux outils de vente. ## CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES • Capacité de stimuler le rendement ministériel en dépassant les objectifs financiers et de l'ICP, en identifiant les possibilités commerciales et en contribuant au succès global des magasins - essentiel dans des milieux de détail de luxe performants. • Compétence démontrée dans la prestation d'un service client exceptionnel par la présence au magasin, l'exécution de cérémonies de marque et le règlement proactif des plaintes. • L'expérience préalable dans le luxe ou les marques premium est essentielle pour répondre aux attentes élevées des clients. • Forte capacité de leadership et de motivation pour inspirer, coacher et développer une équipe commerciale. • L'expérience dans des environnements rapides est essentielle pour maintenir l'énergie et la concentration tout en favorisant le talent. • Un communicateur efficace capable de partager des idées, de diriger des séances d'information et de collaborer entre les ministères. Rester informé des tendances du marché, en particulier dans le secteur du luxe crucial pour maintenir la pertinence et stimuler l'innovation ## Cosa offriamo Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la quête d'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. BUT DE L'EMPLOI Nous recherchons des talents dans la zone Store Design qui seront chargés de développer des projets techniques et de soutenir la réalisation de projets pour Prada Group Stores, en mettant l'accent sur la présentation de produits et le timing des projets, en collaborant avec d'autres fonctions de l'entreprise (Ingénierie de détail, Interior/Display/Windows/Light Design, Project Management et Visual Merchandising). ## RESPONSABILITÉS - Réaliser des conceptions techniques pour les magasins Prada Group avec un design d'intérieur particulièrement ciblé, en s'occupant également de présentations pour l'examen, l'approbation et la mise en oeuvre du projet; - Soutenir le responsable de la conception technique du commerce de détail en vérifiant l'installation et la coordination des travaux, y compris par des inspections sur place au besoin; - Soutenir le processus de création de la conception du magasin; - Soutenir les relations avec les fournisseurs afin de contrôler les prototypes et les progrès de la construction du magasin, en collaboration étroite avec le bureau d'achat de l'ingénierie du commerce de détail; ## CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES - Diplôme en architecture/conception interne/ingénierie civile; - 2/3 ans d'expérience dans le rôle; - Connaissance professionnelle de systèmes de conception tels qu'AutoCAD, Photoshop, Office et Adobe; - Connaissance de Revit ou d'un logiciel de système de modélisation est un plus; - Fluent en italien et en anglais; - Très bonnes compétences en travail d'équipe, axées sur les détails, fortes compétences analytiques. ## Cosa offriamo Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la quête d'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Le groupe Prada favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant des chances égales à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

Come uno dei leader mondiali nel settore della moda, siamo dedicati a fornire esperienze eccezionali alla nostra stimata clientela. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che mettiamo sul talento e sulla passione della nostra gente che porta alla propria crescita professionale. Prada Group promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità per tutti i candidati, indipendentemente dal sesso, dall'etnia, dall'orientamento sessuale, dalla disabilità o da altre caratteristiche personali. descriptionByLocale.en: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB DETAILS We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Stock Supervisor (m/f/d) to join our dynamic team in our PRADA Dusseldorf Store. As a Stock Supervisor, you will play a crucial role in ensuring smooth operations and maintaining the highest standards of inventory management. You will contribute to our commitment to luxury, style, and innovation by overseeing stock procedures, ensuring the availability of products, and maintaining a secure environment for our esteemed clientele. At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and as the Stock Assistant, you will play a pivotal role in upholding our standards and ensuring a seamless customer experience. RESPONSIBILITIES • Ensure to properly manage the daily goods receipt, to arrange the merchandise following the corporate procedures, checking and preparing the product to be taken on the sales floor and/or special areas. • Assure the right product flow tracking through the SAP system. • Guarantee the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process. • Always maintain order in the warehouse, according to corporate standards. • Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines. • Provide the orders of packaging material according to the store's needs. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 2+ years experience ideally in the Retail luxury sector High affinity for luxury products High sense of responsibility and working in a team Fluent German and English skills Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Job Summary/Purposes : The Assistant Store Manager has the ability of promoting brand loyalty to customers in the luxury goods sector, in order to guarantee the quantitative and qualitative objectives assigned. He/she represents the Company and acts as a representative of the Store Manager ensuring the implementation of all directions received from the Retail Department and Store Manager. Responsibilities: Sales • Is constantly up-to-date regarding fashion trends, knows and monitors competitors and communicates this information to the Sales Staff. • Reflects the corporate image in terms of standing and ensures that the Staff is also aligned. • Supports the Store Manager in guaranteeing excellent customer welcome and service and in maintaining the qualitative standards required by our brand. • • Supports the Store Manager in reporting all significant information to the Area Manager. Customer management and CRM • • Personally manages all critical situations regarding customer complaints and after-sales service. • Promotes customer loyalty. • Coordinates the management of Top clients as well as VIPs with the Store Manager. Store Staff • Supports the Store Manager in building the team and coordinating the activities in order to make sure that team members are always motivated and competent. • Ensures professional growth and training of the staff, sharing development plans with the Store Manager. • Supports the Store Manager and Department Managers in the definition of quantitative and qualitative objectives and ensures they are achieved by analyzing results, verifying monthly activities and setting up yearly assessments. • Prepares the Store Planning and submits it to the Store Manager for approval. • Manages Department Managers and supports them in their activities. • Makes sure that internal procedures are followed. Product • Ensures that the Store image and product care are in line with corporate standards and that the Staff is made to feel responsible to maintain these standards . • Knows in depth all the products for each category Visual • Ensures that the Store windows are always in good order and prepares product display strictly complying with the Company directions and following the indications provided by the Store Manager. Stockroom • Optimises stockroom management in order to make sure that stocks are stored as efficiently as possible in terms of sales, in cooperation with the stockroom staff. • Supervises and reports any discrepancies to the Store Manager. • Verifies the correct rotation of goods in the stockroom. • Provides the Stationary orders with the contingent Stock support • Supports the Store Manager in the management of all activities connected with year-end, sector and rotation stock takes by product category. Procedures • Takes any measures to guarantee the care of all valuable products and materials in the store, in cooperation with the Stock Manager. • Liaises with the Store Manager to report and manage any loss (thefts of products, money, etc.). • Liaises with the Store Manager to train the Store Staff to prevent losses and thefts. Reporting • Provides and analyses the main reports in terms of sales, products, staff performances, CRM and Stock. • Supports the Department Manager the reporting activity. Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Church’s is a luxury shoemaker of rich innovation and traditional excellence, anchored in an exceptional heritage of English craftsmanship. Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women.

## Mansioni

- Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
- Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
- Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
- Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
- Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
- Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
- Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
- Prove Brand and product knowledge.
- Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
- Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
- Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts.

## Requisiti

- Passion for selling and stores
- Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design
- Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients
- Being able to work in team as well as alone
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving
- Passion and knowledge of the managed product category

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

## Contatto
No contact information provided.
descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Church’s è un calzolaio di lusso di ricca innovazione ed eccellenza tradizionale, ancorato in un eccezionale patrimonio dell’artigianato inglese. Fondata a Northampton nel 1873, l'esperienza del marchio si è rapidamente guadagnata il riconoscimento dal suo modesto inizio – da un piccolo workshop a Northampton all'espansione globale. Il suo patrocinio fu conferito da HM Queen Elizabeth II nel 1965.
